background_incidence: Pre-outbreak average incidence 1.8/100,000/year (5-yr average before outbreak); rose to 25.2/100,000 during 2009-2011 outbreak; Thailand overall regional incidence 0.9-83.6/100,000 (2013)
outbreak_frequency: Two related outbreaks: 1st Oct 2009-Mar 2010, 2nd Sep 2010-Jul 2011, separated by ~5-month remission (Apr-Aug 2010); 2nd wave larger than 1st; outbreak ended with cases returning to historical (endemic) norms
endemicity: Thailand endemic for typhoid; incidence low outside outbreaks but varies markedly by region and outbreak status
seasonality: No clear seasonal cycle reported; remission during Apr-May coincided with school summer break, not intrinsic seasonality
notes: PFGE showed same strain pattern across schools/months, suggesting common source; vaccination not used since source-control measures were expected to suffice
